result.document_summary: A scraped page of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 1 Article 2 (Divisions 8-9) on administrative civil penalties and administrative citations for code violations, served under a URL for the rent-algorithm ban section.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only general code-enforcement procedures (civil penalties, notices and orders, administrative citations, hearings, and appeals). It does not state any rule in the six in-scope categories, including the algorithmic rent-setting prohibition suggested by the URL, so no records were extracted.
